## Notes

- Maximum battalion-equivalent units (full-strength counters) a parent may have attached beyond its assigned structure (SPI 19.5, restated in rules/70-organisation.md); 'units' on the chart are battalion-equivalents unless the row says company. Any division or brigade may attach two non-SP company-equivalents on top (free_company_equivalents), subject to the same type restrictions
- restrictions caps a type within the maximum; 'tank' means battalion-equivalents of tank points, 'infantry' all infantry types except machine-gun and heavy-weapons units, motorised or not (chart key). restriction_mode 'each' = the row's '1 Infantry and/or 1 Tank'; 'combined' = '1 Infantry or 1 Tank'
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 100) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p6): 0 of 20 rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
